author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (analysis-standin)

prerequisites: Disposable lab openlaw-docs-41255c61-analysis-r1 from app commit 3fa407e3 with the real Document engine and worker.
Per role, a Contract with a download-only primary placeholder and fictional Word, PDF/Word, TXT/PDF and malformed-PDF/PDF Document chains uploaded through the API by that role.
scenarios.expected: Comparison operands and output are correct; an exported redline is a new derived Version with provenance. Pending/failed processing and unauthorized export are handled; a Comparison is not misrepresented as a Version. A plain TXT input is checked as an unsupported extracted-text format.
scenarios.actual: 9 recorded steps and 1 supplementary step passed for Nadia Haddad (Legal Team Member). Compare with previous from the Document and from Version 2's actions opened v2 → v3 and v1 → v2; with the lab worker paused the page read Preparing comparison and changed to Changes without a reload; no Version was added. Older and Newer opened each pair at once, kept the older Version first and offered no Generated redline; insertions and deletions (sixty/thirty, quarterly/monthly) described the newer Version; Next change and Previous change moved the current change. The reader link read Compare with the previous version, 2 changes and opened the stored pair. Export track changes became Open redline and appended Version 4 (generated_redline, from v1 to v2) whose download holds w:ins sixty, quarterly and w:del thirty, monthly; Open redline opened version 4; a repeat export returned Version 4 (200); reopening added nothing; Version 4 was refused as an operand (400). PDF v1 → Word v2 showed the extracted-text notice and Export needs two Word files. with no export (409). TXT v1 → PDF v2 failed with Version 1 does not support extracted text. and two working Download links; reopening returned the same failed Comparison with no retry; a corrected PDF added as Version 3 compared as No changes with different bytes; a malformed PDF pair failed with Version 1 text extraction failed. With the Document archived, Changes stayed readable with no export (409), and a never-compared pair on an archived Document still reached Changes; with the owning Contract archived the export was refused beside the control (409); after Restore the v2 → v3 export appended Version 5 with ninety, annually inserted and sixty, quarterly deleted. Close comparison returned to the Contract's Documents section. A Business User on the Contract team landed on /portal and was refused the Comparison request and export (403).

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer. It is not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
Browser contexts were 1440x1000 CSS px in the default theme. No narrow layout, other theme, keyboard-only or assistive technology check was made.

Prerequisite records were made through the lab API by the acting role or the Administrator: Contract types and Fields, Contracts, uploads of Documents and Versions, Document restore, and Business User team membership. Each is listed in the walkthrough setup notes.

The first three full runs had failures from harness faults or transient page stalls on a loaded host. Their logs are kept as walkthrough-r1-attempt1.json to attempt3.json. The recorded run walkthrough-r1.json passed every step on the same article bytes and build.
The walkthrough ran in a disposable lab, openlaw-docs-41255c61-analysis-r1, built from the committed app source by scripts/documentation/lab.mjs. The lab was destroyed after the run.
Contributor accounts no longer exist (DD-023), so the earlier Contributor rows are not repeated. The unauthorized-role check used a Business User on the Contract team.
The Preparing comparison state was held by pausing only this lab's worker container, then resuming it in the same step.

A Word file that the engine cannot compare, other download-only formats than TXT, and a failed export caused by the engine were not exercised. The export refusal and retry path was exercised with an archived owning Contract.
The corrected PDF Version and all fixture Versions were uploaded through the API; the article's Add version control belongs to the Document Versions guide.
